sql: SELECT 'ledger' AS g, count(*)::text AS a, coalesce(max(at)::text,'-') AS b, coalesce(sum(residual_cents)::text,'-') AS c, coalesce(count(*) FILTER (WHERE residual_cents IS NOT NULL AND abs(residual_cents) >= 1)::text,'-') AS d FROM incentive_balance_observations UNION ALL SELECT 'errors', count(*)::text, coalesce(max(at)::text,'-'), coalesce(max(left(detail_json::text,120)),'-'), '-' FROM incentive_collector_events WHERE kind='loop_error' AND at > now() - interval '2 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'alimm_orders', count(*)::text, coalesce(max(created_at)::text,'-'), '-', '-' FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1'
